evidence.quote: our goals remain to simplify our capital framework while maintaining the overall amount of capital in the U.S. banking system.
The first element of the SCB proposal that I believe should be removed is the stress leverage buffer requirement.
Right now, our policy is to maintain a 0 percent CCyB when vulnerabilities are within the normal range, as they happen to be now.
